integrity.method: size and ETag from ListObjectsV2, compared against the previous data/manifest.json. R2 returns the plain MD5 as the ETag for single-part uploads, so this fingerprints every object at zero egress.

notes.canonical_location: raw/ holds exactly one object per (symbol, date). Nothing resolves a path at read time; config/corrections.yaml is a historical record, not a mechanism.
notes.integrity_baseline: The integrity block compares the live listing against the data/manifest.json present before this run. Re-running re-baselines, so the durable record of a drift is the git diff of this file.
notes.no_signal_content: This inventory deliberately contains no prices, returns or any other outcome-derived statistic.
notes.row_count_caveat: Prefix row totals are extrapolations from exactly counted sampled files. Only sampled_rows_exact is a measured number.
notes.session_convention: CME Globex session opens 17:00 America/Chicago and the session date rolls there; files are split on UTC day, so one session spans two files.
